item_description:
Script: 'bru tsha.
Lines per folio: 10.
Handwritten folio numbering in Arabic numbers (probably modern) mixing up the proper order of the folios. 
Archaic orthographic characteristics, old prefix alternation, and unusual spellings (see [WL39GVT5]: 937-938).
